fields.System.Title: INV-404 — Block a location's stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want blocking a location to make its stock unallocatable, so that
a damaged rack or a contamination area is taken out of use in one action.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a location is blocked, then its stock is excluded from availability without any
  • balance row being edited.
  • - Given existing reservations against stock in that location, then they are released and
  • the orders flagged.
  • - Given the location is unblocked, then its stock returns to availability.
  • - Given a blocked location, then its stock can still be counted and moved out by an
  • authorised operator.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, masterdata, outbound |
| Tables | stock_balance, location, reservation |
| Risks | Blocked-location stock still allocated ([doc 09 §8.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
